articles.title: Rams star Myles Garrett could reportedly be sidelined longer than expected
articles.summary: Garrett could potentially be out until nearly the midway point of the season.
articles.body:
Los Angeles Rams star pass rusher Myles Garrett could remain sidelined from knee surgery until nearly the halfway point of the season, NFL Network reported .

Garrett was given a six-week timeline after his knee surgery, NFL Network's Ian Rapoport reported. That could potentially keep him out until the Rams' Week 9 game against the Washington Commanders on Nov. 8.

Garrett is "determined to beat the timeline," but the Rams want to be cautious with his recovery, Rapoport reported. Garrett has a minimum four-game stint on the IR, which means the earliest he could return is Week 6 against the Arizona Cardinals on Oct. 18.

Garrett underwent arthroscopic surgery on his left knee after struggling in Los Angeles ' Week 1 loss to the San Francisco 49ers . The knee had bothered him throughout training camp and the reigning NFL Defensive Player of the Year didn't record a single tackle against the 49ers.

The Rams acquired Garrett in a blockbuster offseason trade with the Cleveland Browns that sent Jared Verse and multiple draft picks to Cleveland.

Rams coach Sean McVay has not publicly announced a specific timeline for Garrett's return.

articles.title: Cowboys and Lions among teams to call Steelers about potential trade for Joey Porter Jr.
articles.summary: Porter has yet to play this season as he recovers from a back injury and seeks a new contract.
articles.body:
The Dallas Cowboys and Detroit Lions have inquired about Joey Porter Jr. as a potential trade market for the Pittsburgh Steelers star cornerback begins to take shape, ESPN's Adam Schefter reported.

The Cowboys and Lions were among "a handful of teams" who have called the Steelers about Porter, ESPN reported. The Steelers are said to be willing to listen to offers.

The Cowboys and Lions have both suffered significant injuries to their secondary since the start of the season.

Porter has yet to play this season as he recovers from a back injury and is listed as questionable for Pittsburgh's Week 3 game against the Cincinnati Bengals .

He also is seeking a new contract but said this week that he will play this season once he is healthy . Pittsburgh historically has not engaged in contract renegotiations during the season.

Porter spoke for the first time this week since the start of the season and called the passing of his contract extension deadline "old news."

Porter also addressed reports that he sought a second opinion on his injury, calling them false. And he denied asking the Steelers for a trade despite reports suggesting that was the case .

articles.title: Bears QB Caleb Williams reportedly has Grade 2 hamstring injury and could be sidelined for a month
articles.summary: Williams injured his hamstring near the end of the Bears' loss to the Minnesota Vikings in Week 2.
articles.body:
Chicago Bears quarterback Caleb Williams has a Grade 2 hamstring injury and could potentially be out up to a month, ESPN reported .

Williams injured his hamstring near the end of the Bears' loss to the Minnesota Vikings in Week 2.

The estimated timeline for a Grade 2 hamstring injury is three-to-four weeks, though Williams is determined to be back sooner, ESPN reported.

The Bears have called Williams only "week-to-week." He is out for their Week 3 game against the Philadelphia Eagles . Backup QB Tyson Bagent is in concussion protocol and has not yet been cleared to play. Case Keenum could start against the Eagles in their place.

Bears head coach Ben Johnson initially told reporters that the news on Williams' injury was "somewhat encouraging." He also acknowledged that Williams is "likely to miss some time."

ESPN reported that the Bears "have tried to keep the extent of his injury under wraps for competitive-purpose advantages."

"This guy's a little bit different than the average human being," Johnson told reporters earlier this week. "I said that last night, I'll double down on that. He gets back — he has in the past — a lot faster than what people can anticipate, and so I'm not putting a timeline on this. We're going to say week-to-week. He's going to attack this with everything that he knows."

articles.title: Puka Nacua injury update: Rams star could return in Week 4, surgery still on the table if he can't improve
articles.summary: The Rams believe Puka Nacua is dealing with a short-term injury.
articles.body:
Los Angeles Rams star wideout Puka Nacua is unlikely to play when the team takes the field for Week 3's game against the Denver Broncos on Sunday night. While he hasn't been ruled out yet, Nacua was listed as doubtful on the team's injury report after not practicing the entire week due to a groin injury.

But the team believes it's possible Nacua will be back in Week 4, per ESPN's Adam Schefter. The team believes Nacua is capable of taking the field now, but would not show the same level of explosiveness. Because of that, the Rams view Nacua's injury as a short-term thing, and believe he'll get back to work soon.

With that said, it's still possible Nacua could undergo surgery on his groin. If the wideout doesn't show improvement, a procedure would be the next option. The team, however, does not believe Nacua needs to have surgery to correct the issue.

Nacua, 25, has been sidelined since the team's Week 1 game against the San Francisco 49ers in Australia. Nacua played in that contest, hauling in five catches for 74 yards, but developed groin and hip issues during the game. Despite a long layoff between Week 1 and Week 2, Nacua was unable to face the New York Giants last week.

While Nacua apparently managed both issues, Schefter reported Sunday that Nacua's groin is the main concern.

Rams head coach Sean McVay caused some concern ahead of Week 3 when he said Nacua was " not making great progress " in his return from the injury. McVay described the issue as "pre-hernia" and said the team would err on the side of caution with Nacua. "Once you get to a certain point," McVay added, "then I think you feel pretty good moving forward."

The Rams are hopeful that can happen as soon as the team's Week 4 game against the Philadelphia Eagles . The team, however, should have little incentive to rush him back. Despite missing Nacua in Week 2, the Rams pulled off a dominant 28-6 win over the Giants. It was a return to form after the Rams were easily dispatched by the 49ers in Week 1, and gave the team and Nacua some breathing room moving forward.

articles.title: Jason and Kylie Kelce’s latest $2.9 billion market move marks a new milestone as their investment reaches 5,000+ stores
articles.summary: Jason Kelce is expanding his post-NFL business portfolio, with his latest move taking him into the growing hot sauce market.
articles.body: Jason Kelce is expanding his post-NFL business portfolio, with his latest move taking him into the growing hot sauce market. Through Winnie Capital, the family office supporting the business and philanthropic activities of Jason and Kylie Kelce, a strategic equity investment has been made in Hank Sauce, the Sea Isle City, New Jersey-based brand that has grown from a local favorite into a product sold in thousands of stores. The deal gives Hank Sauce another major name behind its plans for wider national distribution while also adding a growing consumer brand to the Kelces’ business interests.Jason Kelce backs a brand he already knew wellHank Sauce announced the strategic equity investment from Winnie Capital on December 22, 2025. Neither side disclosed the financial terms, meaning the amount invested and the size of the equity stake remain private.Kelce’s connection to Hank Sauce, however, goes beyond the investment. The former Philadelphia Eagles center has spent considerable time around South Jersey over the years and was already familiar with Hank Sauce and its Sea Isle City restaurant before the business relationship developed.According to reporting surrounding the deal, Winnie Capital formally connected with the Hank Sauce founders in September 2024. That eventually developed into the investment announced more than a year later.This distinction is important. Kelce is not simply appearing in an advertising campaign for the company. Winnie Capital has taken an equity position in the existing business, while Jason is also expected to contribute to brand awareness, content and marketing as Hank Sauce attempts to reach a larger audience.Kylie Kelce is connected to the deal through Winnie Capital, which serves as the family office for the couple’s business and philanthropic activities. The announcement does not disclose a separate personal investment from Kylie, so her role is more accurately described through the family’s investment operation.Jason also brings something that cannot be measured simply by the undisclosed investment figure. After 13 NFL seasons with the Eagles and a growing media career that includes the New Heights podcast with Travis Kelce, he has an audience that can introduce Hank Sauce to consumers far beyond its Jersey Shore base.Hank Sauce has already reached more than 5,000 storesWinnie Capital is investing in a company that has already spent years building its business.Brian “Hank” Ruxton, Matt Pittaluga and Josh Jaspan founded Hank Sauce in 2011. The business started on a much smaller scale before gradually expanding its production, restaurant operation and retail distribution.Hank Sauce now says its products are available in more than 5,000 retail locations nationwide. Its distribution includes retailers such as Publix, GIANT, ACME, ShopRite, Sprouts, Cabela’s and Ace Hardware, giving the company a footprint that already stretches well beyond New Jersey.The business also operates from a 10,000-square-foot manufacturing facility in Millville, New Jersey, a major change from its early years when production was considerably smaller and bottles were made by hand.Its Sea Isle City restaurant, meanwhile, dates back to 2012 and remains an important part of the company’s connection to the Jersey Shore.The product itself was built around a straightforward idea. Rather than competing only on extreme heat, Hank Sauce has focused heavily on flavor. That approach has allowed the company to appeal to customers who enjoy hot sauce without necessarily looking for the hottest product possible.Winnie Capital investment comes as Hank Sauce targets a much bigger marketHank Sauce is trying to expand in a sizeable category. The U.S. hot sauce market has been valued at roughly $2.9 billion, according to market figures cited in reporting surrounding Kelce’s investment.The opportunity for Hank Sauce is therefore much larger than its original Jersey Shore customer base.The company already has several pieces needed for further expansion, including its own production facility, more than 5,000 retail locations, an established product lineup and over a decade of operating history. The next challenge is increasing national recognition while continuing to add retailers, restaurants and other distribution channels.That is where Winnie Capital’s investment and Jason Kelce’s involvement could play a role. Along with providing capital, the partnership is expected to include work around content, marketing and brand visibility.For Kylie Kelce, the deal is connected to the broader activities of the family office she shares with Jason rather than a separately announced personal investment. For Jason, it gives him an equity interest through Winnie Capital in a company he was already familiar with as a consumer.Hank Sauce has now been operating for around 15 years, has expanded into more than 5,000 stores and produces its sauces from a 10,000-square-foot New Jersey facility. articles.title: De'Von Achane limps off field with knee injury on Dolphins' first drive
articles.summary: De'Von Achane touched the ball multiple times on the team's first drive before the injury.
articles.body:
The Miami Dolphins came into the season with low expectations, but running back De'Von Achane was the one player who could carry the team to respectability. But the Dolphins experienced their worst-case scenario in Week 3, as Achane limped off the field on the team's first offensive drive.

Achane's injury came on the team's fifth play of the game. He had three carries for 17 yards on the Dolphins ' first drive before the injury.

Achane was able to get up after the play, but was tended to by trainers before he gingerly exited the field.

He eventually walked back to the locker room and was deemed questionable to return with a knee injury.

Any missed time for Achane would be devastating for a Dolphins team bereft of offensive talent. After cutting Tua Tagovailoa and Tyreek Hill , and trading away Jaylen Waddle , Achane was the last man standing on offense.

While Miami could have traded Achane away, the team instead opted to give the 24-year-old a four-year, $68 million extension. He was expected to be the focal point of the team's new-look offense with Malik Willis under center.

Since joining the NFL in 2023, Achane has emerged as a star. He turned in his best season in the NFL last year, rushing for 1,350 yards and scoring eight rushing touchdowns. That performance resulted in Achane being elected to the Pro Bowl for the first time in his career.

articles.title: Are Justin Herbert and Patrick Herbert brothers? Their Oregon and Chargers connection explained
articles.summary: Patrick Herbert is about to experience an NFL moment that has been years in the making.
articles.body: Patrick Herbert is about to experience an NFL moment that has been years in the making. The Los Angeles Chargers elevated the tight end from their practice squad Saturday ahead of their Week 3 matchup against the Buffalo Bills, putting him in line to make his NFL regular-season debut alongside his older brother, Chargers quarterback Justin Herbert. For the Herbert family, however, this is not the first time the brothers have shared a football field.Justin and Patrick were previously teammates at the University of Oregon in 2019. Seven years later, they are reunited as NFL teammates, only this time with Justin throwing passes in the NFL and Patrick trying to make his mark at tight end.Meet Patrick Herbert, Justin Herbert's younger brother who is making his NFL debut Patrick Herbert is a 25-year-old tight end who played college football at Oregon, following in the footsteps of his older brother. Three years younger than Justin, Patrick spent six seasons with the Ducks from 2019 through 2024. He finished his Oregon career with 31 receptions for 388 yards and four touchdowns, including six starts during his senior season in 2024.Unlike his brother, Patrick did not enter the NFL as a highly touted first-round selection. He went undrafted in the 2025 NFL Draft and signed with the Jacksonville Jaguars as an undrafted free agent. After failing to make Jacksonville's initial 53-man roster, Herbert spent the 2025 season on the Jaguars' practice squad. That made his path to an NFL game considerably different from Justin's.Patrick Herbert followed Justin to OregonPatrick arrived at Oregon in 2019 while Justin was entering his senior season as the Ducks' starting quarterback. Justin helped lead Oregon to a 12-2 record that season and a Rose Bowl victory, while Patrick appeared in two games as a true freshman. Despite being teammates, the brothers never connected for a pass.Patrick did not record a reception during that 2019 season, meaning Justin never had the opportunity to throw his younger brother a game pass. Their reunion with the Chargers therefore creates a chance to finish something they started at Oregon but this time on an NFL field.How did Patrick Herbert end up with the Chargers?After spending the 2025 season with Jacksonville, Patrick joined the Chargers' practice squad in 2026, reuniting with Justin. The move gave the brothers another opportunity to be teammates after their brief overlap at Oregon. Reuters reported that Patrick signed with Los Angeles in September after spending the previous season with the Jaguars.Patrick's promotion to the active roster came because the Chargers were dealing with injuries at tight end. With David Njoku and Charlie Kolar unavailable, Patrick was elevated to provide additional depth for the matchup against Buffalo. CBS Sports reported that Herbert was expected to serve as the team's No. 3 tight end behind Oronde Gadsden and Hayden Rucci.Patrick Herbert and Justin Herbert could make NFL historyThe most intriguing part of Sunday's reunion is obvious: Could Justin Herbert throw a pass to Patrick Herbert? The brothers never connected at Oregon, so a completion between them would be a first for their professional careers.And a touchdown would carry even more historical significance. NBC Sports reported that the last brother-to-brother touchdown pass in an NFL game came in 1929, when Chicago Bears quarterback Red Grange threw a touchdown pass to his brother Gardie Grange. The only other known brother-to-brother touchdown pass came in 1924.That means a Justin-to-Patrick touchdown would be an extremely rare NFL occurrence. articles.title: Drake Maye fumbles on pass attempt without being touched for his league-high fifth turnover of the season
articles.summary: A turnover-plagued season for Drake Maye hit a new low on Sunday.
articles.body:
A turnover-plagued season for Drake Maye hit a new low on Sunday.

The New England Patriots were driving on their second possession in a scoreless game against the Jacksonville Jaguars . On first-and-10 from the Jacksonville 35, Maye dropped back for a pass and appeared to be targeting wide receiver Kyle Williams , who had one-on-one coverage on a post route down the right sideline.

But he forgot one thing — to throw the ball. Just before he brought his arm forward to pass, the ball slipped from Maye's hand.

Jaguars defensive tackle DaVon Hamilton recovered the ball, and a promising Patriots possession was over.

Maye wasn't hit. He wasn't even under pressure. The ball just slipped from his hand. Replay confirmed the call on the field that the ball came loose before his arm moved forward.

Here's another look in slow-motion confirming that the ball was out.

Making matters worse for the Patriots, the Jaguars converted the turnover into a 10-play, 62-yard touchdown drive for a 7-0 lead.

The turnover was Maye's fifth this season and his 13th since the start of last season's playoffs in six-plus games. His five turnovers through the first quarter of Sunday's game were tied for the most in the NFL with Falcons quarterback Cooper Rush . As of the time of Sunday's first-quarter fumble, Maye had tallied just one touchdown this season.

By comparison, Maye totaled 11 turnovers in 17 games over the course of the entire 2025 regular season in route to All-Pro honors and a runner-up finish in the MVP race. Until he fixes his turnover issues, the Patriots are going to have a difficult time gaining traction in their quest to repeat as AFC champions.

articles.title: WATCH: Keenan Allen gets first TD with Colts vs Texans
articles.summary: Wide receiver Keenan Allen just got his first touchdown with the Colts to give Indianapolis a 10-point lead against the Houston Texans.
articles.body:
Wide receiver Keenan Allen just got his first touchdown with the Indianapolis Colts in their Week 3 matchup versus the Houston Texans .

The score gave Indianapolis a 10-0 lead in the second quarter in their first AFC South matchup of the season.

Here is a look at the touchdown, courtesy of the Indianapolis Colts ' social media:

With the touchdown, Keenan Allen now has the 12th most receptions in NFL history with 1,063 total receptions across his 14-year career, according to the TV broadcast. It also gave the Colts their first double-digit lead of the season.

articles.title: Watch as Drake Maye's turnover woes continue by letting go of ball for strange fumble vs. Jaguars
articles.summary: Maye now has a turnover in every game this season after strangely letting go of the football in Week 3.
articles.body:
Drake Maye hasn't looked anything like the 2025 version of himself so far in 2026.

After finishing as the runner-up in MVP voting last season, displaying precise passing, strong decision making and athleticism to scramble when necessary, Maye has had a lackluster opening stretch to his third NFL season.

Through two games, Maye was already tied for the league lead in interceptions. Then, on Sunday against the Jaguars , he had one of the most bizarre fumbles you'll see from a quarterback, letting go of the ball despite no pressure.

Here's a look at Maye's latest turnover and how it added to a concerning trend for the Patriots quarterback.

Drake Maye lets go of ball during pass for fumble vs. Jaguars

New England was on the road to face Jacksonville in Week 3, and after going scoreless on their opening drive, the Patriots got the ball back around the mid-way point of the first quarter.

After Rhamondre Stevenson picked up a first down, however, Maye had a strange fumble on the following play. He wasn't being pressured by any Jaguars defenders, and after faking a handoff and looking to throw deep, Maye simply let go of the ball while winding up his pass.

The ball fell to the ground, and DaVon Hamilton jumped on it for a fumble.

There appeared to be no other excuse than the ball slipping out of Maye's hand:

Maye's fumble against the Jaguars represented his fifth turnover already this season. No NFL player has more.

According to Matt McCarthy, 17 of the Patriots opponents' 23 points this season have come off Maye turnovers.

The Patriots quarterback threw three interceptions in one quarter against the Seahawks in Week 1, a loss for New England, then threw another pick against the Steelers with no touchdown passes in Week 2.

Turnovers are quickly growing into a significant concern for the young star after leading his team to the Super Bowl last season.

articles.title: Chargers’ Genesis Smith grabs interception of the year candidate against Josh Allen
articles.summary: Genesis Smith is tormenting Josh Allen.
articles.body:
One of the more bizarre developments in the early window of Week 3 of the 2026 NFL season is unfolding in Orchard Park, New York. The 2-0 Buffalo Bills currently trail the 0-2 Los Angeles Chargers 10-3 in the early going, and quarterback Josh Allen has thrown a pair of interceptions in the first half.

Both of those have come from Genesis Smith, and the second of those might just be the interception of the year.

With the Bills trailing 10-0 and facing a 2nd-and-6 situation in their own territory, Allen tries to go over the top of the Chargers secondary, on this post route to D.J. Moore . But the throw ends up in the hands of Smith, somehow:

This replay angle highlights just how unlikely this interception was, as the ball ends up in Smith's stomach as he rolls over and onto the turf:

His first interception of the day was a little easier, however:

Smith's second interception was the Chargers' third takeaway of the first half, as James Cook fumbled on the first play from scrimmage:

It has been that kind of day for the Bills.

articles.title: Dabhal gram sabha seeks exclusion of Mhaisal, Kamarkand from ESA list
articles.summary: Kirlapal-Dabhal gram sabha urges removal of Mhaisal and Kamarkand from Western Ghats ESA list, citing concerns over housing, roads and livelihoods.
articles.body: Margao: Villagers of Kirlapal-Dabhal have demanded that Mhaisal and Kamarkand be excluded from the proposed Western Ghats ecologically sensitive area (ESA) list, fearing the designation will restrict construction, repairs and other activities in the villages.At a special gram sabha, villagers passed a resolution seeking the exclusion of the two villages from the ESA proposal. They also resolved to forward all objections received over the past several days to the authorities the same day to meet the deadline for filing them.“Our demand is that both villages be excluded from the ESA. If the entire villages cannot be excluded, then at least the residential areas and private properties in these villages should be kept out,” a villager said.Villagers said an ESA tag could affect basic amenities and livelihoods. “If these villages are brought under the ESZ, residents will not be able to build or repair their houses, roads cannot be built in the villages, and fencing for plantations will not be allowed,” another villager said.Sarpanch Damodar Bandekar backed the villagers’ stand.The demand comes amid Union environment ministry’s fifth draft notification issued this year, which proposes 108 Goa villages, covering 1,461 sq km across Sattari, Canacona, Dharbandora and Sanguem talukas, as ecologically sensitive areas of the Western Ghats.State govt has opposed the proposed list since 2024. It initially sought the exclusion of 47 villages and later reduced its demand to 21 villages, seeking a final list of 87 ESA villages.The draft notification, issued on July 27, prohibits mining, quarrying and sand mining within ESAs. Existing mines are required to be phased out within five years of the final notification or on expiry of their leases, whichever is earlier.The notification is open to public objections for 60 days, after which govt will consider issuing the final notification.You Can Also Check: Gold Rate in Goa | Silver Rate in Goa | Bank Holidays in Goa | Public Holidays in Goa | Petrol Price in GoaStay updated with the latest Goa news. articles.title: Broncos player punished by the NFL ahead of important Rams game
articles.summary: A Denver Broncos player just got some bad news ahead of the Los Angeles Rams game.
articles.body:
It doesn't get much bigger in the NFL than a primetime game for all to see, and the Denver Broncos and Los Angeles Rams have just that tonight. They play each other in Denver for a "Sunday Night Football" matchup.

Last week, the Broncos beat the Jacksonville Jaguars in a 20-13 game, so the Broncos are flying high on that win. Both the Broncos and Rams are 1-1 going into this game, so the stakes are high, and it's already an important early-season showdown.

But one Denver player is coming into the game after getting disciplined by the NFL. He was served with a fine on Saturday for actions taken in that game against the Jaguars.

Alex Singleton gets fined ahead of Broncos-Rams showdown

Each Saturday, the league makes decisions to discipline players for breaking the NFL's rules during the games the week prior. According to the NFL's official website , the league "uses the fine schedule to outline the league's and the union's expectations for players to conduct themselves in a way that honors the sport and respects the game, themselves, their fellow players, the fans and the league."

Over the weekend, the NFL fined Alex Singleton of the Denver Broncos $17,911 for unnecessary roughness after he was penalized for a hit on a defenseless player in Week 3. That's one of the bigger fines of the weekend, too. The NFL announced the news in the league's official accountability report .

He's allowed to challenge the punishment. But if he pays it up, the good news is that the fines collected go to the Professional Athletes Foundation and the NFL Foundation , so it's for a noble cause.

articles.title: Josh Allen throws interceptions on consecutive passes after 195 straight attempts without one
articles.summary: Genesis Smith made two excellent plays on Josh Allen in Week 3.
articles.body:
Buffalo Bills star Josh Allen entered play in Week 3 on a lengthy interception-less streak. But Allen met his kryptonite Sunday, and it came in the form of Los Angeles Chargers rookie Genesis Smith.

Smith picked off Allen in the first quarter Sunday, ending Allen's 195-attempt streak without an interception. It was the longest such active streak in the NFL.

Smith read the play — of Allen's eyes — perfectly, jumping in front of the intended receiver to make the play.

The Chargers capitalized on Smith's interception, driving down the field and kicking a field goal to take a 10-0 lead over Buffalo.

That put Allen in a spot he hasn't been in all season: Trailing by double digits.

He responded to that adversity by … throwing an interception on his next pass. This one also wound up in Smith's arms.

This time around, Smith showed off his speed and ball instincts, running with Bills wideout DJ Moore all the way down the field and coming up with an incredible catch for the interception.

It was a shocking start for the Bills and Allen, who dropped 36 points in Week 1 and 41 points in Week 2. Allen played a massive role in the team's excellence, scoring nine total touchdowns in those contests.

But that was before he ran into Smith. The fourth-round rookie had not started for the Chargers during the first two weeks of the regular season. By the end of the first quarter Sunday, he was already well on his way to the finest game of his young career.

articles.title: WATCH: Seahawks WR Jaxon Smith-Njigba scores his 5th TD of the season
articles.summary: JSN wants his second Offensive Player of the Year award!
articles.body:
Seattle Seahawks quarterback Sam Darnold is back in action and he has his first touchdown pass of the 2026 season! Trailing 7-0, Darnold helped march his team all the way to the Commanders ' goal line. Seattle's nine-play, 88-yard drive was capped off when Darnold found - who else!? - but his No. 1 wide receiver Jaxon Smith-Njigba in the end zone.

JSN now has five touchdowns on the season thanks to this toss from Sam Darnold.

This drive was aided by a pair of explosive plays. A 20-yard reception to fullback Brady Russell got the Seahawks to the goal line, and a dominant 32-yard reception from tight end AJ Barner set up the pass to Russell.

The Seahawks currently trail the Commanders 14-7 at the time of this article's publication. Follow Seahawks Wire's live blog for more updates, highlights and analysis for this game.
